$comment: Plan W13.H3 — every lucide-react icon the interface imports, sorted into directional (mirrors under RTL with the icon-dir class) and fixed (never mirrors), with the reason. Rules follow Material's bidirectionality guide: mirror what shows a reading direction (back/forward, undo/redo, a side panel, bullets); keep fixed what is physical or symmetric (media controls, clocks and rotation, check marks, code, charts with an LTR axis). A new import that is in neither list fails src/__tests__/iconDirection.test.ts.

directional.ArrowLeft: points back along the reading direction (back / previous)
directional.ChevronLeft: previous / back in the reading direction
directional.ChevronRight: next / forward, submenu and disclosure arrows point toward the inline end
directional.ExternalLink: the arrow leaves the box toward the inline end (SF Symbols and Material mirror it)
directional.List: bullets sit at the inline start of the lines
directional.LogIn: the arrow enters the door from the reading side
directional.LogOut: the arrow leaves the door toward the reading side
directional.MessageSquare: the speech bubble's tail is on the inline start side
directional.MessageSquareWarning: the speech bubble's tail is on the inline start side
directional.PanelRightClose: the side panel sits on the inline end, which is the left in RTL
directional.PanelRightOpen: the side panel sits on the inline end, which is the left in RTL
directional.Quote: the quote mark opens the line at the inline start
directional.Redo2: redo goes forward in the reading direction (Material mirrors undo/redo)
directional.Reply: reply points back to the earlier message, against the reading direction
directional.Undo2: undo goes back against the reading direction (Material mirrors undo/redo)

fixed.Activity: a pulse trace; charts in the app keep an LTR time axis
fixed.BadgeCheck: a check mark is never mirrored (Material)
fixed.BarChart3: charts in the app keep an LTR value axis
fixed.Calculator: a physical object; its keypad is not mirrored
fixed.CaseSensitive: Latin letters Aa; text is not mirrored
fixed.Check: a check mark is never mirrored (Material)
fixed.CheckCircle2: a check mark is never mirrored
fixed.CheckSquare: a check mark is never mirrored
fixed.CloudOff: the slash is a fixed 'off' mark
fixed.FileText: a sheet with lines; Material keeps 'description' fixed
fixed.History: a clock turns clockwise in every language (Material keeps clocks fixed)
fixed.ImageOff: the slash is a fixed 'off' mark
fixed.Plane: a travel object, not a reading direction
fixed.Play: media controls show tape direction, never mirrored (Material)
fixed.RefreshCcw: circular arrows show rotation, which is physical
fixed.RefreshCw: circular arrows show rotation, which is physical
fixed.ShieldCheck: a check mark is never mirrored
fixed.ShieldOff: the slash is a fixed 'off' mark
fixed.Tag: a tag points diagonally; no reading direction
fixed.Terminal: a terminal prompt is always LTR
